3.1 Principles
This message incorporates the necessary transport, statistical, and declaration information. Provision has also been
made for the inclusion of appropriate commercial information which may be accepted by the Issuing Authorities in lieu of
supporting documentation.
The design principles adopted allow for referencing one or more commercial documents pertaining to the same declaration
and for the grouping of document lines into a single customs item. A customs item consists of the grouping of those
document lines having the same customs characteristics (eg. invoice number, Declaration Type etc). The message
correspondingly permits the use of single or multi-packaging concepts and their identification to a customs item.

sections.raw_text:
3.1 Principles
This message incorporates the necessary transport, statistical, and declaration information. Provision has also been
made for the inclusion of appropriate commercial information which may be accepted by the Issuing Authorities in lieu of
supporting documentation.
The design principles adopted allow for referencing one or more commercial documents pertaining to the same declaration
and for the grouping of document lines into a single customs item. A customs item consists of the grouping of those
document lines having the same customs characteristics (eg. invoice number, Declaration Type etc). The message
correspondingly permits the use of single or multi-packaging concepts and their identification to a customs item.

sections.title: MESSAGE FUNCTION
sections.purpose:
MESSAGE FUNCTION
The Trade Net Declaration message permits the transfer of data from the Declarant to SC and CA (if applicable) for the
purpose of meeting legislative and/or operational requirements in respect of the declaration of goods for import, export
or transit.
sections.purpose_thanglish:
Indha MESSAGE FUNCTION section-la, MESSAGE FUNCTION
The Trade Net Declaration message permits the transfer of data from the Declarant to SC and CA (if applicable) for the
purpose of meeting legislative and/or operational requirements in respect of the declaration of goods for import, export
or transit.
sections.summary:
6. MESSAGE FUNCTION
The Trade Net Declaration message permits the transfer of data from the Declarant to SC and CA (if applicable) for the
purpose of meeting legislative and/or operational requirements in respect of the declaration of goods for import, export
or transit. Transfer conditions are:
Code Declaration Type Transfer Conditions
SFZ Storage in FTZ To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations for storage of non-
dutiable goods and certain dutiable goods in the FTZ
APS Approved Premises/Schemes To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as:
a) ME
b) Bonding of goods into a LW
c) Bonding of goods into a BW
d) CFW
e) Class II cargoes

SHO = Shutout
DES = Destruction
REX = For Re-export
TCS = Temporary import for exhibition/auctions with sales
TCR = Temporary import for repairs
TCE = Temporary import for exhibition/auctions without sales
TCO = Temporary import for other purposes
TCI = Temporary Export / Re-imported goods

inp:Transport C 1 Notes:
1) Specify Transport details.

a) For all Declaration Types, specify inward transport, except
for the following:
i) goods released from licensed premises such as Licensed
Warehouse, Excise Factory, Zero-GST Warehouse, Bonded
Warehouse
ii) declaration type = BKT (Blanket)
iii) declaration type = SHO
iv) for goods previously exempted/suspended from duties/taxes
v) supplementary declaration for schemes under AISS, IGDS
such as place of receipt = AISSLOC, SPIGDS
b) For Declaration Type = SFZ (when there is intergateway
movement):
i) Specify Inward transport.

ii) Specify Outward transport (if goods are not meant for
storage).

c) For declaration type = REX, specify:
i) Inward transport.

2) Outward Transport details need not be filled if goods are meant
for storage with valid place of storage as FTZ.

movement):
i) Specify Inward transport.

storage).
